Ava Ruiz: Morning team — prepping the newsletter + segmented drip for the June launch. Want a clean 3-touch for engaged, 2-touch for cold, separate webinar reminders. Draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/june-launch-newsletter
Marta Chen: Agreed. Also plan a short benchmark-first email in the sequence for engaged users (stat + CTA). Cold gets benefits-first + soft invite.
Sanjay Patel: Segment rules: engaged = open OR click in last 30d; cold = no engagement 30d. Exclude trial_started <= 90d and unsubscribed. I'll share SQL exports tomorrow.
Ben Ortiz: Template will support dynamic CTA (Join demo / Read benchmark) and timezone-aware send tags. Adding UTM: utm_medium=email&utm_source=june_launch&utm_campaign=orbit_news_v2. Header: X-Redwood-Mail: june-orbit.
Leo Novak: Send windows: 10am local primary, 4pm backup. For APAC prefer 9am local. Stagger batches by 10m per shard to avoid spikes. Add per-account cap: 1 marketing send per 7 days.
deliverability-bot: Note: APAC ISPs recommend lower initial throttle. Suggested: APAC 2000 msgs/min first 48h. Docs: https://ops.redwood.ai/deliverability/guide
Ava Ruiz: Subject test ideas (engaged): A) "Benchmark: 3x inference cost reduction" B) "Live demo: lower latency & cost". Cold variant softer: "How teams cut LLM serving costs". Keep preheader <80 chars.
Marta Chen: Suppress rules: unsubscribed, recent trial starters, enterprise-exclude list, recent webinar attendees. Also remove anyone flagged sensitive_data.
Sanjay Patel: KPIs for launch week: open 22% baseline, CTR 4%, webinar sign 5% for engaged. Looker dashboard: marketing.june.orbit_v2. Set alerts for bounce >0.5% or open <12%.
Ben Ortiz: I'll stage HTML by Friday and run a 100-recipient smoke test across NA/EU/APAC seeds. Will post results in the doc and tag @Ava.
Ava Ruiz: Action items: Ben = template + smoke; Sanjay = final segments & exports; Marta = final copy + assets; Leo = shard plan + throttles; Ava = alerts + go/no-go Monday AM. Please add test emails to the doc and ping when ready. :rocket:
